node.statement: By lem-stage1-unitary-graph-control, g_V is C^1 (hence continuous), takes values in the permitted H-ball, satisfies Phi_V(P',g_V(P'))=0, and is the unique such graph branch there; shrink O_P and O_Q around (P,g_V(P)) so continuity keeps g_V(O_P) inside O_Q, then the implicit zero-set equivalence forces g_V=F on O_P. Doing this at every P proves g_V is C^infinity everywhere on its original domain; equality with the original C^1 function is pointwise, so uniqueness of derivatives leaves its existing first derivative unchanged.
